svg.title: Roadmap: dependency view
svg.desc: Every task of the roadmap in its group's column, at the level of its longest chain of hard dependencies; solid arrows are hard dependencies (gates), dashed arrows are placements by choice.
svg.text: Each task sits in its group's column, at the level of its longest chain of hard dependencies: level 0
needs nothing else. A solid arrow points from a task to one that needs it (a gate). A dashed arrow points
from a task to one placed after it by choice.
